drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 51-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.89, creatinine 0.85-1.03, hemoglobin 14.5-14.6, platelets 221, sodium 141, wbc 6.8-7; vitals dbp 77-81, heart_rate 85-89, map 95-99, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 132-138, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.2-1.4, hemoglobin 14.6, platelets 225-227, sodium 141, wbc 6.6-6.8; vitals dbp 77-83, heart_rate 85-89, map 97-100, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 17-18, sbp 135-139, spo2 97-99, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Hold lisinopril; Lactated Ringer's 1 L IV bolus
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 51-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
